mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.5% signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 45% of instances when UNRATE < 5.5%, or the directional accuracy falls below 55% in backtests.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer demand and labor market strength, supporting corporate profit expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 50% of instances with both RSAFS and PAYEMS growth, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2%) in a high inflation regime signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in high inflation regimes is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output and supply chain resilience, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances with rising INDPRO, or the correlation between INDPRO growth and SPX returns falls below 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1000 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing market, reducing consumer wealth and economic growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 55% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or the directional accuracy drops below 60% in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates aggressive monetary easing in response to economic weakness, triggering short-term equity market rebounds and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 45% of instances with joint FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized > 2%) in a robust economic expansion regime supports corporate earnings momentum and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2%, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 in strong growth regimes is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
